data.name: San Kalimba
data.detailed_description:
A High Seas Adventure

Take the time to listen to the gentle crash of the waves and slow down your pace. Step aboard your vessel and let yourself be carried by the calm waters of the San Kalimba archipelago. Between the swells, cast your line, throw your net, and simply enjoy the moment. But make no mistake—beneath this apparent tranquility, something seems to be watching you...

Fishing Hauls, Artifacts, and Sailing

Amidst the rolling waves, take part in various mini-games where timing and precision will guide your catches, whether using a rod or a net. Hoist up treasures and strange artifacts using your grappling hook and your skill. The captured creatures and recovered items can be displayed in a peaceful aquarium or enrich a museum dedicated to preserving the secrets of the deep. Use your rewards to upgrade your boat and explore the archipelago at your own pace.

Exploration and Mystery

Between sailing from island to island and swimming amidst mysteries, take the time to observe each location and its atmosphere... The locals have things to say, and their tales will reveal more than you might think. Through your encounters and completed quests, the fragments of history surrounding the enigma of the fog that constantly looms over the archipelago will slowly unfold, as your curiosity pushes you ever deeper into this hidden narrative.

Between Land and Sea

Once your hold is filled with discoveries, head back to Naya Island. This is your home base in the heart of the archipelago, where every expedition begins and ends: a place to rest and prepare before heading back out to sea. In the kitchen, harvests from your garden, your fishing haul, or purchases from the merchant will allow you to best prepare for your upcoming explorations. Your home is your anchor: decorate it with your finds, pick out your best outfit, and organize your departures your own way towards the mysteries of San Kalimba.

A Cozy and Intriguing Atmosphere

Dive into an adventure where tranquility is tinged with mystery, set in meticulously crafted Pixel Art environments that blend coziness with the uncanny. From warm lighting to soothing seascapes and comforting landscapes, the archipelago exudes an atmosphere that is as relaxing as it is intriguing. Sail to the rhythm of an original soundtrack that evolves throughout your day, inviting you to slow down, contemplate, and understand the echoes of the past.

data.short_description: Play as a young fisherman in the San Kalimba archipelago in this relaxing adventure game. Sail your boat, find treasures, mysterious artifacts, and rare fish ! Explore the bottom of the sea to discover all its secrets.
